objective.title: Compare pinned managed symbolic providers and qualify conditional-result selection evidence

declared.summary: Open M4 and qualify only M4-W01-C01-T1 by comparing AngouriMath 2.5.0 and MathNet.Symbolics 0.25.0 as independently restored .NET 10 symbolic provider smokes. Observe polynomial derivative, elementary roots, rational cancellation with x!=1 carried as a conditional result, actual MIT package metadata and SHA-256s. Select Angouri only as a provisional Math-side candidate, retain other engines as comparison/deferred, and keep T2/resource and C02 typed-IR bridges unqualified.
declared.value: Ground the initial symbolic provider choice in isolated executable mathematical and provenance evidence while refusing domain-losing simplifications and protecting provider-neutral Math runtime boundaries.
debtChanges: Two independently restored and compiled managed .NET 10 provider projects use separate NuGet caches, avoiding a MathNet.Symbolics numeric dependency collision with M3 MathNet.Numerics 5.0.0.
AngouriMath 2.5.0 must show a symbolic derivative residual of zero, elementary ±1 roots and a condition-bearing rational cancellation; no unconstrained x=1 result may pass.
MathNet.Symbolics 0.25.0 must show derivative/point-value oracles, but is not credited with domain-condition preservation or polynomial root-solver capability.
An archive-only C# helper observes the actual restored MIT packages, dependency IDs, SHA-256 and byte lengths; the DWF payload does not hash its own workflow authorities.
Exact quantities and IR regressions plus locked .NET solution build and product/native planning checks retain existing M0-M3 authority; symbolic providers are test-only.
Out-of-process CAS and Python are not required; native public Math symbolics, cancellation/resource budgets and assumption-preserving IR translation are explicitly deferred.
The first M4 research spike completes only T1 with A/B/C; M4, M4-W01 and C01 stay in progress, while T2 and the next product phases remain not-ready.

The first RS053 invocation was refused before attempt allocation: ActivateReadyContinuation requires an already active ancestor hierarchy. Use the proven RS039 explicit ready-to-in-progress M4/Work/Phase/Task/Question transition chain instead.
declared.nextAction: After durable RS053 success, qualify M4-W01-C01-T2 provider isolation, bounded cancellation and mathematical exclusion/assumption transport before starting C02's typed IR bridge.

achievements.achievement: Fix the small falsifiable symbolic-provider comparison corpus, pinned AngouriMath and MathNet.Symbolics versions, domain-exclusion criterion, and out-of-process deferral.

Observe independent .NET 10 provider-only smoke runs on symbolic derivatives, roots/point values and conditional rational simplification, with exact restored MIT package identities, dependencies and SHA-256s.

Record a provisional Angouri conditional-result candidate, comparison-only MathNet scope, provider-isolation and false-adoption restrictions, leaving cancellation/IR interoperability for separate work.
